resources.string: Octagonal field rings pulse outward. Long press holds the field.
Melchior, Balthasar and Casper deliberate. Long press for the decision.
Battery level with a ring gauge; long press shows the time. Flashes an emergency frame in battery saver. Works on always-on.
Five minutes of internal power counting down. Long press starts or pauses it, and refills it once it runs out.
The Angel alert: a flashing frame with the pattern scrolling through. Long press switches between Pattern Blue and Pattern Orange.
